text:
deploybot: Promotion HOLD: deploy-scheduler reporting queue throttle in prod-west (27 pending jobs). Affected rollout: canary for release v2.14.3. CI showed parallel-integration timeout. Action: holding promotion until investigation.

alice: saw logs — failing test is `int::billing::charge-flow` on runner-12, error looks like DB connection reset during handshake.

ben: is this the same timeout pattern as yesterday? runner autoscale might not be kicking.

carla: deploy-scheduler metrics: sudden spike in queue length after artifact fetch retries. API returned 429 when trying to enqueue promote job. snippet from scheduler logs:
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z scheduler ERROR enqueue failed: 429 throttle -- queue_len=27 retries=3
2026-03-21T14:02:13Z runner-12 WARN integration timeout after 120s
```

dave: options: 1) pin canary to last-known-good image (sha abc123def) and manual-promote now, 2) wait for CI rerun with increased timeout. Tradeoffs: pin avoids missing change window but skips latest commit.

alice: prefer pin+manual-promote to avoid customer impact, but want a quick smoke run after promote.

ben: I'll trigger a CI rerun with extended timeout (120s -> 240s) on the parallel-integration job for verification. If it passes, we can unhold and promote head. Rerun id run-789 queued.

deploybot: CI re-run queued by @ben: run-789. Current queue position: 12. ETA ~10m.

eva: FYI change-window closes in ~35m. If rerun finishes after that, we'll miss the window.

carla: alternative: manual promote pinned sha abc123def to canary now, then run expanded-timeout verification post-promote. Risk: we skip the most recent bugfix commit.

dave: what's in the delta between abc123def and head? release notes show only docs + small perf tweak. Low risk.

alice: confirmed: only one commit ahead (deps bump + perf tweak). I'm +1 for pin and manual promote.

ben: ok I'm initiating pin + manual promote. tagging ops for rollback plan and monitoring.

deploybot: Manual promote initiated by @ben. Promote job id=prom-202. Starting canary rollout to prod-west.

carla: monitor scheduler queue and canary health checks (latency, 5xx rate). If queue spike recurs, roll back to earlier image and open follow-up.

eva: leaving note: update release notes to reflect pinned sha in canary and open ticket INFRA-2345 to investigate scheduler autoscale/rate-limit behavior.

ben: will follow up with a CI pass update in ~10m. If rerun succeeds we can unpin later and promote head in the next window. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Promote progress: canary at 50% traffic, health checks OK so far.
